category_note: Fifteen lamps, ten valid: mostly slim 0.35-0.55 m footprints but all 1.24-1.96 m tall, so size is borderline at best. Natural in living rooms, bedrooms and hotel suites but normally beside furniture (N=2); several arc lamps too wide.
